title: London Family Adventure: Pixar, Harry Potter, Dinosaurs & Minecraft
summary: A 2-day trip in Greater London for a family of four with kids aged 7 and 11 who love Pixar movies, Harry Potter books, Minecraft, and dinosaurs. The itinerary blends popular landmarks with taste-matched museums and parks, includes halal meals and prayer stops at mosques, and keeps walking distances short for family comfort.

tips: Use contactless payment for London transport; kids under 11 travel free on buses and trams.
Check mosque websites for updated prayer times and any visitor guidelines.
Carry a reusable water bottle and snacks for the kids during museum visits.
